def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(g):
    bg=g[0][0]
    # pattern cells: non-bg, non-zero
    pat=[[(x,c) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x not in (bg,0)] for row in g]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(pat) for _,c in row]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,_ in cells),max(r for r,_ in cells)
    c0,c1=min(c for _,c in cells),max(c for _,c in cells)
    P=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]]
    M=[row[::-1] for row in P]  # horizontal mirror
    # zero region bbox
    zc=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==0]
    zr0,zc0=min(r for r,_ in zc),min(c for _,c in zc)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,row in enumerate(M):
        for j,x in enumerate(row):
            out[zr0+i][zc0+j]=x
    return out

d=G['Demo pair 1 input']; o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print(transform(d)==o)
import json
print(json.dumps(transform(G['Test input'])))
